extracted.intended_audience: corporate clients, corporate communications leaders, investor relations teams, deal sponsors, and counsel involved in M&A transactions
extracted.subtask_description: Advising and executing communications across the M&A deal lifecycle — from pre-announcement planning through transaction announcement to post-merger integration — to increase the likelihood of a successful close and smooth integration. Emphasis on coordinating across investor relations, public affairs, digital and employee communications to manage stakeholder sentiment and regulatory risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhance the certainty of a successful close
rubrics_metrics.description: Advises clients across every stage of the deal lifecycle to enhance the certainty of a successful close.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Position communications activity and timing to increase the likelihood the transaction completes as planned; coordinate messaging, stakeholder engagement, and disclosure to reduce surprises or opposition that could derail the deal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approach each transaction as a multi-faceted campaign
rubrics_metrics.description: Our experts approach each transaction as a multi-faceted campaign.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat the deal as a coordinated campaign that integrates multiple channels and audiences rather than isolated announcements; plan messaging, sequencing, and channel mix holistically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover the full deal lifecycle (pre-announcement to integration)
rubrics_metrics.description: From pre-announcement planning to transaction announcement and post-merger integration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide tailored activity at each stage: pre-announcement to prepare stakeholders and mitigate risk; transaction announcement to control narrative and market reaction; post-merger integration to retain employees, customers, and preserve reputation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop and drive positive deal sentiment across stakeholder groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop and drive positive deal sentiment across stakeholder groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and target key stakeholder groups (investors, employees, regulators, customers, media, public) with appropriate messages and channels to build support and reduce resistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimize regulatory risk and threat of shareholder dissent and activism
rubrics_metrics.description: Minimizing regulatory risk and threat of shareholder dissent and activism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anticipate regulatory scrutiny and activist investor responses; craft disclosures, engagement strategies, and contingency messages to limit regulatory issues and shareholder challenges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrated expertise across relevant communications disciplines
rubrics_metrics.description: An unparalleled combination of expertise in transaction communications, investor relations, public affairs, digital platforms and employee engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage cross-disciplinary capabilities (IR, public affairs, digital, internal comms) so messaging is consistent and effective across channels and audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-announcement planning
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Early planning to align timing, messaging, stakeholder outreach, regulatory considerations and media strategy so the announcement proceeds with maximum control and minimum disruption.
